mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, warehouse_id, virtual_warehouse_id, sku_id, sku_no, bill_date, qty, dict_inventory_status, virtual_trans_flow_id, batch_no, last_outstock_date
mapper.select:
WITH VirtualInventory AS ( SELECT sku_id, warehouse_id, virtual_warehouse_id, SUM(qty) AS virtualQty, SUM(CASE WHEN dict_inventory_status = 'usable' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS virtualUsableQty, SUM(CASE WHEN dict_inventory_status = 'frozen' THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS virtualFrozenQty FROM virtual_inventory WHERE is_deleted = false GROUP BY sku_id, warehouse_id, virtual_warehouse_id ), VirtualInventoryHis AS ( select sku_id, warehouse_id, virtual_warehouse_id, sum(qty * avg_inventory_age_days) / count(0) as avgInventoryQty from virtual_inventory_his where is_deleted = false group by sku_id,warehouse_id,virtual_warehouse_id ) select vi.sku_id as skuId, pd.sku_no as skuNo, pd.name as productName, wh."name" as warehouseName, vw.code as virtualWarehouseCode, vw.name as virtualWarehouseName, vi.virtualQty, vi.virtualUsableQty, vi.virtualFrozenQty, now() as date, case when vi.virtualQty = 0 then 0 else round(COALESCE(vih.avgInventoryQty,0)/ vi.virtualQty,2) end backAvgInventoryAge from VirtualInventory vi left join VirtualInventoryHis vih on vi.sku_id = vih.sku_id and vi.warehouse_id = vih.warehouse_id and vi.virtual_warehouse_id = vih.virtual_warehouse_id left join product_detail pd on vi.sku_id = pd.id and pd.is_deleted = false left join warehouse wh on vi.warehouse_id = wh.id and wh.is_deleted = false left join virtual_warehouse vw on vi.virtual_warehouse_id = vw.id and vw.is_deleted = false
${params.sqlMap.default} order by
${item.field} ${item.sort}
vi.sku_id desc

select vih.date, vih.avg_inventory_age_days from virtual_inventory_his vih
vih.is_deleted = false and vih.sku_id = #{params.skuId} and vih.warehouse_id = #{params.warehouseId} and vih.virtual_warehouse_id = #{params.virtualWarehouseId}
and vih.date >= #{params.dateList[0]} and (#{params.dateList[1]}::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1 DAY' ) > vih.date
order by vih.date asc
